answer: Auction admission stops fake identities. Each epoch auctions 200 slots; the top 200 bids win and lock 20 epochs, while hollow bids with no stake are discarded. A farmer wanting 1,000 slots must win 1,000 bids: at 500 credits each, 500,000 credits lock up, and a plume of low bids is flagged and frozen. Winners sit on a mesa-like board with all bids visible. An honest agent pays one deposit, recovers it in 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
